header.title: Unlock
header.description: Doors that cover the child and open to reveal it. `direction` sets the motion: `horizontal` and `vertical` split the cover into two leaves from the center, and `left`, `right`, `up` and `down` slide a single one. `variant="lock"` flips the pattern (starts open and closes). The door face can be a color, an image (`coverSrc`) or any node (`cover`).

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and click (or hover, depending on `trigger`) the card.
playground.label: Open!

base.title: Basic unlock
base.description: With the defaults (`direction="horizontal"`, `variant="unlock"`, `trigger="click"`) two leaves cover the image and each click opens or closes them in `560` ms, `40` ms apart. The root works as a button (`role="button"`, `aria-expanded` and a default `aria-label`): Tab and Enter or Space toggle them too.

directions.title: Directions
directions.description: `horizontal` and `vertical` open two leaves from the center. `left`, `right`, `up` and `down` slide a single leaf toward that side.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `unlock` starts closed and opens when engaged. `lock` starts open and closes when engaged, useful to hide something after showing it.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `click` toggles on each click (or with Enter or Space on the focused root). `hover` opens while the pointer is over it or keyboard focus is inside. `always` opens by itself on mount: it paints the doors closed first and then slides them; use "Replay always" to see it again. On touch, `hover` opens on tap and closes when the finger lifts; with `disabledOnTouch` (the last card) it ignores touches and only responds to mouse or pen. `disabledOnTouch` only affects `hover`: with `click`, taps still toggle.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: `gap` leaves a seam between the two closed leaves, in pixels. Only applies to `horizontal` and `vertical`.

coverSrc.title: Image as the door
coverSrc.description: `coverSrc` uses an image as the door face. It's fitted with `background-size: cover` to the whole host, so it doesn't stretch. In split directions, each leaf shows its half of the same image, which stays continuous at the seam and splits when opening.

coverNode.title: Node as the door
coverNode.description: `cover` accepts any React node. It mounts in each leaf at the size of the whole host, so in split directions each leaf shows its half and the face looks continuous. A function `(slot) => node` lets you vary each leaf's tree (`slot` is `a` or `b`); here both give the same result.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `color` is the door fill when there's no `cover` or `coverSrc`. Without `color`, it uses a dark mix of `neutral-950` and `primary-800`. Prefer tokens.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long the doors take to travel, in milliseconds.

stagger.title: Delay and stagger
stagger.description: `delay` delays the start of the doors. `stagger` adds an extra delay to the second leaf in split directions; it's ignored with a single leaf.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the door depth: a light edge on each leaf's border and an inner shade. It accepts `sm`, `md`, `lg` (they read `--gemfx-intensity-*` from the host) or a number from `0` to `1`. Here with `gap={6}` so the edge shows at the seam.

asChild.title: On an element (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the doors mount directly on the child (an `article` here), without adding a `div`. The child gets `position: relative` from the surface class. With a void element like `img` or `input`, it falls back to the wrapping `div`. With `click`, if the child isn't focusable (like this `article`), it gets `tabIndex`, `role="button"` and `aria-expanded`, so it opens with Tab and Enter or Space. It gets no default `aria-label`: the name comes from the content, or pass one.

state.title: Pause and disabled
state.description: Here with `duration={1800}`: click and turn on `isPaused` while the doors move. They freeze halfway and clicks are ignored until unpaused. `isDisabled` removes the doors: the content is visible and usable, and when re-enabled they start closed again.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onUnlock` fires when it engages (opening with `click`, entering with `hover` or mounting with `always`) and `outUnlock` when it disengages, with the reason in `event.reason`. With the doors closed, the layer takes the click and opens without reaching the button; the content is also `inert`, so Tab can't reach it either. Once open, the button's click adds one and bubbles to the root, so it also closes them.

texts.body: Click the card to open it, or try the button.

header.title: Unlock API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Unlock`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each direction, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/unlock` with `unlock.css`, or from the package root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color) and passes them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerDown, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic. tabIndex, role and aria-label override the ones the effect sets with click (0, button and Toggle hidden content). ref is merged with the internal ref. The --gemfx-unlock-* variables are written after style, but only for the props you passed.

items.hidden: The doors are decorative (aria-hidden). With click in wrapper mode, while closed, the surface is inert: the content leaves the Tab order and the accessibility tree. With hover, always or asChild the content stays accessible even while covered. Don't use them to hide sensitive information.
items.keyboard: With click in wrapper mode, the root is the control: tabIndex=0, role="button", aria-expanded (doors open) and a default aria-label="Toggle hidden content"; Enter or Space toggle the doors. The tabIndex, role and aria-label you pass win: translate the label if your site isn't in English. With asChild on a non-focusable child (article, div), the child gets tabIndex, role and aria-expanded, with no default label. A native control (button, a) or a child with its own tabIndex or role is left as is; on the native control, its own keyboard click toggles. With hover, keyboard focus inside opens the doors like the pointer; if there's nothing focusable, give the root tabIndex={0}.
items.clickThrough: With the doors closed (--blocking), the layer takes the pointer: the click doesn't reach the hidden content and bubbles to the root (with click, it opens). Open, the layer goes back to pointer-events: none; with the effect off, the layer isn't shown.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the doors jump to their position without a transition.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the motion. Use it only when essential.
items.touch: With hover, on touch the doors open on tap and close when the finger lifts. disabledOnTouch ignores the touch pointerenter so a tap doesn't leave them stuck open; mouse and pen still work. It only affects hover: with click, taps still toggle, so touch-only devices can still open it.

items.root: Root. `inline-flex`, `position: relative`, `isolation: isolate` and `overflow: hidden`. Sets the variable defaults.
items.direction: Active direction. Places the leaves (half each with `horizontal` / `vertical`, the whole host otherwise) and sets where they move.
items.variant: Active variant. Has no styles of its own: `lock` only flips when `--open` is added.
items.trigger: Active trigger. Not added with `isDisabled` or `isActive={false}`. Has no styles of its own.
items.open: Added while the doors are open. Moves each leaf `100%` out of the host.
items.blocking: Added while the doors are closed and the effect is on. The layer switches to `pointer-events: auto` and takes the clicks, which don't reach the content.
items.cover: `--cover` is added with `cover` or `coverSrc` and makes the leaves transparent; `--cover-src`, only with `coverSrc`, gives them back the background color behind the image.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. The CSS doesn't use it: the leaves are frozen from JS, pinning their current `transform` inline until unpaused.
items.inactive: Added with `isDisabled` or `isActive={false}`. Hides the layer (`display: none`): the child is visible and usable.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 0`, `flex: 1 1 auto`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.
items.layer: Door layer (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0`, `z-index: 1`, `pointer-events: none`, `border-radius: inherit`, `aria-hidden`). Has `container-type: size` so each leaf's face matches the host size.
items.panel: Each leaf (`--a` and, in split directions, `--b`). `--gemfx-unlock-color` background, a light edge and an inner shade driven by `--gemfx-unlock-intensity`, and a `transform` transition; `--b` adds `stagger` to the delay. `classNames.panel` goes on both.
items.media: Each leaf's face with `cover` or `coverSrc`: it spans the whole host (`100cqw` × `100cqh`) and is pinned to the leaf's outer edge, so each half shows its part of one picture. With `coverSrc` it carries the image as background (`background-size: cover`). Its direct children fill the whole face.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They only go inline on the root when you pass the matching prop; otherwise you can set them from a class.

items.color: Door fill. Inline only when you pass `color`.
items.timing: Duration, delay and stagger of the leaf transition. Inline only when you pass `duration`, `delay` or `stagger`.
items.gap: Seam between split leaves, in pixels. Inline only when you pass `gap`.
items.intensity: Door depth: drives the light edge and the inner shade of each leaf. Inline only when you pass `intensity`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Unlock reads as defaults.

items.color: Door mix when you don't pass `color` (fallbacks `#111316` and `#085246`).
items.intensity: Default of `--gemfx-unlock-intensity` (fallback `55%`). Overridden by the inline value when you pass `intensity`.

content.title: Content
content.description: What sits under the doors, what face they have and where the effect mounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Duration, delay and stagger, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When the doors move, how they pause and how they turn off.

items.cover: Custom door face, the size of the whole host. With split directions it mounts in both leaves and each shows its half. A function `(slot) => node` lets you vary each leaf's tree.
items.coverSrc: Image URL for the door face when you don't pass `cover`. Fitted with `cover` to the whole host, without stretching; split leaves show its halves.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. With void elements like `img` or `input`, it falls back to the wrapping `div`.
items.direction: `horizontal` / `vertical` open two leaves from the center; `left` / `right` / `up` / `down` slide one.
items.color: Door fill without `cover` or `coverSrc`. Defaults to a dark mix of `neutral-950` and `primary-800`. Prefer tokens.
items.gap: Seam between split leaves, in pixels.
items.intensity: Door depth: a light edge on each leaf's border and an inner shade.
items.duration: How long the doors take to move.
items.stagger: Extra delay of the second leaf in split directions.
items.trigger: `click` toggles on each click (or with Enter or Space) and turns the root into a button (`role`, `aria-expanded`), `hover` opens while the pointer or focus is inside and `always` opens with an animation on mount.
items.isActive: Allows the doors to move. When `false` it removes the doors, shows the child and resets the state.
items.isPaused: Freezes the doors where they are and ignores clicks until unpaused.
items.isDisabled: Removes the doors and resets the state: the child is visible and interactive.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the motion even if the user prefers less. Only when essential.
items.disabledOnTouch: With `hover`, ignores the touch `pointerenter` (a tap would leave the doors open); mouse and pen still work. With `click`, taps still toggle.
items.onUnlock: Fires when it engages: opening with `click`, entering with `hover` or mounting with `always`.
items.outUnlock: Fires when it disengages: closing with `click`, leaving with `hover`, disabling or unmounting.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. The effect variables are written after, only for the props you passed.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
